title: PetSmart Pet Grooming Locations - Indianapolis, Indiana

facts.fact: PetSmart's Indianapolis grooming salon is located at 7801 US Hwy 31 S, Indianapolis, IN 46227.
The PetSmart Indianapolis grooming salon lists its phone number as 317-865-3509.
The PetSmart Indianapolis grooming salon's listed Sunday hours are 8am to 6pm.
The PetSmart Indianapolis grooming salon's listed hours from Monday through Saturday are 7am to 9pm.
facts.quote: Mon 7am - 9pm Tue 7am - 9pm Wed 7am - 9pm Thu 7am - 9pm Fri 7am - 9pm Sat 7am - 9pm

facts.fact: PetSmart states its academy-trained Pet Stylists in Indianapolis bring over 800 hours of hands-on experience to appointments.
facts.quote: our academy-trained Pet Stylists bring over 800 hours of hands-on experience to the appointment

facts.fact: PetSmart's Quick Services Options at the Indianapolis salon include nail trims, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning, offered as walk-in services.
